queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords to search for. Leave empty to browse by tag/date only (e.g. latest front-page stories or the newest Who's Hiring thread).

tags.title: Filter by tag
tags.description: story, comment, poll, ask_hn, show_hn, job, front_page. Listing several tags returns items matching ANY of them (they are OR-ed): ["story","comment"] returns both stories and comments, ["story"] alone returns posts only.

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: If tags includes 'comment', set true to fetch comment text too. Set false to drop comments; if 'comment' is the only tag you asked for, the run is skipped with a warning rather than silently widening the search to every other content type.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: 'relevance' ranks by search relevance and points; 'date' returns the newest items first.

minPoints.title: Minimum points
minPoints.description: Only return stories/comments with at least this many points.

minComments.title: Minimum comments
minComments.description: Only return stories with at least this many comments (e.g. find high-engagement discussions).

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop any story/comment whose title or text contains any of these words/phrases (case-insensitive). HN's search has no negative-term syntax, so this is applied to the matches after fetching, before you're charged -- e.g. queries:["rust"], excludeKeywords:["cryptocurrency"] keeps rust-the-language discussions and drops rust-the-crypto-project ones.

author.title: Author username
author.description: Only return items posted by this exact HN username.

usernames.title: User profiles to look up
usernames.description: HN usernames to fetch profile data for (karma, about text, account creation date) — a separate lookup from the story/comment search above. To fetch ONLY user profiles with no story search, also set 'Search queries' and 'Filter by tag' to empty ([]).

watchLabel.title: Watch label (only new since last run)
watchLabel.description: Optional. Name a saved search (e.g. "my-launch-watch") and this run returns ONLY story/comment/job hits not delivered under that same label and filter set before, instead of the full match set every time. The first run for a label is a free baseline: it records what already matches (up to 5000 hits) and returns zero rows. Run it again later -- on a schedule, typically -- to get only what's new. The baseline is kept in your own Apify account (a named key-value store), keyed by label plus a fingerprint of queries/tags/author/sort/date-range/point-comment thresholds, so changing any of those starts a fresh baseline instead of dumping previously-excluded items as "new". Applies to the query/tag search only -- 'User profiles to look up' still runs and is charged normally every time, since a profile snapshot isn't a discrete new item.

enrichGithubLinks.title: Enrich GitHub links
enrichGithubLinks.description: When a story/comment's URL or text links to a GitHub repo (common on Show HN and technical discussions), looks it up on GitHub's public API and adds star count, primary language, last-push date, and open-issue count. Off by default -- adds one extra request per distinct repo found, bounded to 200 lookups per run against GitHub's unauthenticated 60/hour limit; repos already looked up earlier in the same run are cached, not re-fetched.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (notify on completion)
webhookUrl.description: Optional. An http(s) URL to POST a small JSON summary to when the run finishes -- items pushed, hits scanned, and (when Watch label is set) whether this was a baseline run plus the new/skipped counts, along with the run's dataset ID so you can fetch the results. A convenience for callers who want a completion ping without setting up an Apify platform webhook (which needs separate Console/API configuration per Task, not per run). Best-effort: a failed or slow webhook is logged as a warning and never fails the run or affects charging -- it fires after every item has already been pushed and charged. Leave empty to skip.
